summary: Coherent waiting message and a self-healing retry for a transiently locked keyring.
changelog: Only the folder at the head of the wait queue names the folder it is waiting on; the rest show the generic 'Waiting for another folder to finish…' (issue #169).

A transiently locked password keyring (the Secret Service not being ready right after login) now schedules a capped backoff retry and clears on its own once the service is ready, instead of staying locked until restart (issue #170).
